name: ai-media-workflow
description: Local-first visual workflow canvas for AI product media: projects, spaces, references, master script, scenes, prompts, provider adapters and Markdown export/import.

scripts.dev: npm run setup && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.start: npm run setup && npm run build && npm run start -w backend
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p providers && tsc -p backend && tsc -p frontend
